title: docs(skills): a template hole's default is literal text; an in-app send that reached nobody is refused
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DXuamRUC67fx2TTYrFfyuSH)_

Refs #32678, #32825 — the governed skills/docs lines those two cards' PRs (#33321, #33347) owe and could not carry. Land after both: each line describes behaviour those PRs ship.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: this PR is the follow-up.

## Maintainer quick read

- What changes: one clause in the automation skill and one paragraph in the administrator guide. No code.
- Why: #33321 adds the `email-template-default-reads-as-path` warning (a template hole's `default:` argument is literal text, never a variable path); the ruling on #32678 asked for that line in skills too. #33347 makes the in-app message door refuse a send that reached nobody (409/503) instead of confirming it; the administrator guide still said only that the confirmation counts recipients.
- Risk and rollback: text only; revert to roll back.
- Needed from you: a Tier H approval (`skills/**` is governed).

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`: the text-slot rule ("holes — a variable path, optional formatter, no logic") now says a `default:` argument is literal text, never a path. Paid for under the token ratchet by trimming the "When to Use" line, which restated the frontmatter description (flows, state machines, approvals, triggers): the file measures 6860 against its ceiling of 6861.
- `content/docs/permissions/administrator-guide.mdx`, "Send a message to your organization": the confirmation counts the people a delivery was accepted for; a send that reached nobody is refused, `409` when every picked person turned the topic off, `503` when delivery could not be made or, for Everyone, when the member list could not be read or every member turned the topic off.
- `.changeset/a2-skills-docs-32678-32825.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Verification

Local, on head `64296ca8`: `check-skills-token-ratchet` (automation SKILL.md 6860 / 6861), `check-skill-links`, `check-skill-identifier-liveness`, `check-skill-frame-sync`, `check-skill-top-level-keys` and `check-empty-changeset` all exit 0.
